faq: Shopify has rules for combining discounts, and we set them on purpose so offers stack only when you want them to. We test combinations at checkout so you do not give away more than planned.
Do you run the ads for the sale?
No, this service builds the offer and the store side of it. Ads and social posts are separate services, but we can use the same sale details if you order them too.
Can you make a sale for one customer group?
Yes, with customer segments or a single-use code. Tell us who it is for and we set up the rule, then test it with a sample account so only the right people can use it.
What about prices that must stay legal?
We help you set clear start and end dates and show original prices honestly. Rules on sale pricing differ by country, so check yours; we never add fake countdowns or invented was prices.
